name: Onam
overview: The name Onam appears in Scripture as both a son of Shobal and a son of Jerahmeel, highlighting his place within the genealogical records of the Old Testament. Specifically, Onam is listed among the children of Shobal in Genesis 36:23 and 1 Chronicles 1:40, and also as the son of Atarah, wife of Jerahmeel, in 1 Chronicles 2:26, with his own descendants named in 1 Chronicles 2:28. These passages emphasize the importance of family lineage and heritage in God's unfolding plan, demonstrating how each individual, including Onam, fits into the broader biblical narrative of God's chosen people.
